summary.normalization: NFC, casefold, punctuation-to-space, collapse whitespace; CER excludes spaces
summary.permission_note: Declared by dataset owner; audit does not verify legal rights
summary.leakage_note: Rejects repeated speaker IDs and exact audio/PCM duplicates; cannot detect renamed speakers or near-duplicate audio

selection: 8 original-train speakers for training, 3 original-train for validation, 3 original-test for test; first eligible clips per speaker in archive order
limitations: Small pilot of read speech; not a general conversation benchmark. Whisper pretraining overlap is unknown. Preserve official attribution and NC/SA/academic restrictions; not approved for commercial deployment.
